# Raven Inkwell

Raven is Princess Celestia's bespectacled secretary: the pony who makes royal administration run smoothly while the heroes go adventuring. She is a minor G4 television character but gets a substantial diplomatic adventure in the licensed IDW comics.

[![Raven Inkwell fan art by justsadluna, with an IDW comic reference](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/download/2024/4/10/3203283.png)](https://twibooru.org/3203283)

*Appearance:* White coat, brown eyes, dark brown hair in a bun, black rectangular glasses, white collar and red cravat. Her cutie mark is a pen and inkwell. She appears both as an Earth pony and a unicorn; no transformation is established. See the [character color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/134-Raven-Inkwell).

*Name and voice:* The [character wiki](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Raven_Inkwell) lists her as unnamed on television. Celestia calls her Raven in IDW's Micro-Series #8 (2013); the full Raven Inkwell name appears on [Hasbro blind-bag merchandise](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bags/details/18wbri/). The wiki classifies the name as fan-originated, but its original coiner is unverified. She audibly gasps in her television debut, but no spoken dialogue or credited voice actor was verified. She has dialogue in the comics.

*Appearances:* Luna Eclipsed (S2E4), dressed as a devil for Nightmare Night; The Crystal Empire, Part 1 (S3E1), serving Celestia; Filli Vanilli (S4E14), holding a clipboard near Mayor Mare; and Spice Up Your Life (S6E12), in Restaurant Row. Her comic appearances include Friendship is Magic #7, Micro-Series #8, Friends Forever #3 and #61–62. She is also playable in [Gameloft's mobile game](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Raven_Inkwell).

## Important moments

- **At the royal throne — [The Crystal Empire, Part 1 (S3E1)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165297/s03-e01-the-crystal-empire-pt-1).** Raven assists Celestia just before news of the Crystal Empire arrives, establishing her royal aide role. [Show capture, Hasbro/DHX production](https://manebooru.art/images/640250). Timestamp unavailable.
- **Paperwork matters — Convocation of the Creatures!, IDW #61 (2017).** Raven helps Twilight investigate the archives, where an old treaty threatens Equestria's ownership of Canterlot.
- **Saving Canterlot — Convocation of the Creatures!, IDW #62 (2018).** After the archivists find proof that Equestria paid for the land, Raven gets the document to Celestia despite Goldstone's interference and shares the credit with her new friends.
- **The unsung diplomat — Convocation of the Creatures!, IDW #62.** Raven reveals that she prepared nine drafts of the Appleloosa–buffalo treaty following Over a Barrel, then chooses to return to her behind-the-scenes work.

[Comic arc synopsis and dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Convocation_of_the_Creatures!) and [issue #62 credits](https://comicvine.gamespot.com/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-62-convocation-/4000-656521/). These comic scenes have no television episode or video timestamp.

Verification limits: Some indexed wiki and merchandise pages could not be reopened directly; the linked fan-art post and image were verified. The animated show-capture asset timed out, so it is linked as a post rather than embedded.
